name: lifeboathw.eth

steps.what: 0. deploy the device's PQ wallet (CREATE2 from its public key)
2. Deploy a fresh resolver that only the post-quantum wallet controls (pq.* records set at creation)
3. Point the name at it (the old resolver's role holders stop mattering)
4. Remove operator 0xBE65…e630 (it could transfer all your names)
5. Transfer the name to the post-quantum wallet (ENSv2 accepts it once nobody else holds a role)
